style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, hard noon sun
motion_rule: she runs left on six blurring legs in every beat, the camera running beside her at her height, so the fur walls tear past behind her in every beat; a coat sleeve or a moth wipes the lens in every beat; she fills half the frame height, chest up from 6.8; new shot size each beat, one action per beat; no push in, no rack focus
character: a plump grey clothes moth in a brown mink coat, powdery wings, feathered antennae, deadpan face
second_characters: ONE lean moth in a green clerk visor chasing her at the lens all clip, hurling mothballs and waving a bill; A SWARM of moths crossing the lens in every beat
props: ONE white mothball the clerk hurls at her, more bouncing past her legs; ONE fat folder of bills in her arms; ONE long strip of bills unrolling from it; blank price tags fluttering thick; brass hangers; ONE red-stamped bill in the clerk's grip; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: the mothballs are his and always in flight; the strip whips behind her from 1.3 on, never parked; speech is only heard, never shown
environment: a narrow wardrobe aisle where brown mink fur fills every inch of both walls to the ceiling

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty female voice, deadpan, even 4.4 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: me-NYA, GLO-zhut, sche-TA, dol-GHI, TAK-zhe, PA-ra, shub, NOR-ki, poch-TI, do-YE-la
audio.pacing: 0.4-4.3 one breath; pause 4.3-4.7; 4.7-6.8 one breath; after 6.8 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: her mouth opens on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: fur rustling all clip, running steps, wing flutter, mothballs knocking, paper riffling, one wet spit at 7.6

timeline.a: she bursts into frame at a full run, fur walls tearing past the other way
she rips a mouthful of fur off a passing coat without slowing, the coat sweeping across the lens as torn fur flies back past her
she hurls the folder open at a run, a long strip of bills bursting out across the whole frame as a mothball cracks off a coat by her ear
she crashes shoulder first through a hanging coat, the fur bursting across the lens as she runs on
she backhands a flying mothball away at the lens and swats a coat rack that swings off past her, hangers clattering
she rounds a corner at full run, the strip whipping long behind her, tags tearing off the walls
the clerk shoves the red-stamped bill at the lens and is swept aside as she runs past
she dives through a gap in the fur wall, a solid slab of coats sweeping between her and the lens
the clerk lunges in at the lens waving the bill and she shoulders him out of frame mid-run, coats tearing past
she runs past one stripped hanger swinging empty, the swarm tearing across the lens after her
chest-up: still running, she rips a strip of fur off her own sleeve with her teeth, coats streaking behind
she spits the wad of fur at the lens, face to camera, still running as the fur walls haul past

must_appear: at 2.2 she crashes through a hanging coat, the fur bursting across the lens; at 3.2 she backhands a flying mothball away at the lens; at 6.8 chest-up, she rips fur off her own sleeve with her teeth; at 7.4 she spits the wad at the lens, face to camera
negative_prompt: speech bubble, speech balloon, comic panel, subtitles, watermark, cyrillic, latin letters, printed words on props, letterbox, night, a parked camera, a still background, a hero sitting, a hero riding, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, slow motion, human hands, speech after 6.8
